title: STAGE - Data Engineer/Reporting BI F/H - Mars 2027
location: Pouzauges, Pays de la Loire, France
description:
🚀 Envie de transformer la donnée en véritable levier de décision ? Chez Fleury Michon, la donnée est au cœur de nombreux enjeux business. Pour renforcer notre équipe Data au sein de la DSI , nous recherchons un(e) stagiaire Data Engineer/Reporting BI pour contribuer à la chaîne de valeur de la donnée, de sa structuration jusqu’à sa restitution.
 L’objectif ? Transformer des données en informations utiles et accessibles aux équipes de l’entreprise , grâce à des modèles de données fiables et des rapports Power BI adaptés aux besoins des métiers.

 Comprendre les besoins des métiers
 Échanger avec les équipes métiers (commerce, finance, production, digital…) pour comprendre leurs besoins.
 Traduire ces besoins en modèles de données adaptés.
 Structurer et fiabiliser la donnée
 Développer et optimiser des requêtes SQL sur notre datalake Snowflake : extraction, transformation et modélisation.
 Participer à la fiabilisation et à l’automatisation des flux de données : sourcing, contrôles qualité…
 Documenter les traitements et les modèles de données.
 Transformer la donnée en outils de pilotage
 Concevoir des rapports et modèles Power BI , notamment avec Power Query M et DAX.
 Contribuer à l’optimisation et à la maintenance des rapports et flux existants.
 Participer à l’amélioration de la gouvernance Data et Power BI.
 Accompagner les utilisateurs
 Accompagner les équipes dans l’appropriation des rapports créés.
 Être à l’écoute de leurs besoins et contribuer à faire évoluer les solutions proposées.

title: Senior Data Engineer — Document & AI Pipelines
description:
About Tracium https://www.linkedin.com/company/tracium/
 Tracium builds AI-assisted technical documentation software that turns complex manuals and engineering documents into structured, traceable information. Starting with maritime, we help technical teams extract maintenance information and create documentation through document intelligence and S1000D authoring.
 Your role You will build the data foundation connecting source documents, AI processing, human review, and downstream systems. Your focus will be reliable processing, clear data models, and traceability throughout the document lifecycle.

 Build workflows for parsing, enrichment, validation, indexing, and export.

 Implement document versioning, processing history, and reproducible reprocessing.
 Make pipelines resilient through retries, monitoring, automated checks, and clear failure handling.
 Work with AI engineers to productionise extraction and retrieval workflows.
 Support integrations with authoring tools, customer APIs, and ERP systems.
 What you bring Experience designing and operating production data pipelines.
 Strong Python, SQL, and data modelling skills.
 Experience with workflow orchestration, asynchronous processing, and object storage.
 A practical approach to testing, observability, and data quality.
 Experience with cloud infrastructure, containers, and infrastructure as code.
 The ability to take ownership from initial design through production support.
 Clear communication in English.
 Useful additional experience Document processing, XML.
 Search indexes, vector databases, or AI data pipelines.
 Multi-tenant platforms and private deployment environments.

title: Senior BI/Data Engineer
description:
Your Role in Our Story: 

As a Senior BI/Data Engineer at ACT, you will play a key role in modernizing and scaling our enterprise Data Platform. Combining hands-on engineering with technical ownership, you will design reliable, scalable data solutions across data integration, modelling, analytics engineering and platform architecture.

Beyond delivery, you will help shape our platform roadmap and engineering standards, with a focus on architecture, automation, performance, security and cost efficiency. Microsoft Fabric is an important part of our modernization journey, alongside technologies such as Databricks where they add value. You will also have the opportunity to explore practical applications of Generative AI across development, documentation and platform operations.

We value ownership, collaboration, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement. In essence, your role involves:

  • Own and continuously improve key components of ACT’s Data Platform architecture and engineering standards.
  • Design and implement integrations for new source systems and build reliable, maintainable data pipelines.
  • Design, implement and document enterprise data models, including relational and dimensional models.
  • Develop, optimize and operate data pipelines and orchestration using technologies such as Azure Data Factory, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Functions and Logic Apps.
  • Plan and execute data migrations with appropriate validation, reconciliation, data-quality controls and operational monitoring.
  • Contribute to the modernization of the Data Platform using Microsoft Fabric and, where appropriate, Databricks and other modern data technologies.

description:
Your role at Veezu:
 As a Data Engineer, you'll build and maintain the data platform that powers reporting, analytics and data science across Veezu. Reporting into the Director of Data Engineering, you'll work hands-on with Microsoft Fabric, SQL, Python/PySpark and Power BI, bringing data in from our booking systems, databases and third-party APIs and shaping it into trusted, well-modelled datasets that the business relies on every day.
 Who are Veezu?
 Veezu is the UK's fastest growing taxi and private hire technology business operating across hundreds of UK towns and cities. We are a tech-driven on-demand mobility service that supports our hyper-local communities, helping them thrive and so much more!

 Design, build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines in Microsoft Fabric using Pipelines, Notebooks, Lakehouses, Warehouses and OneLake.

 Develop and optimise SQL transformations, stored procedures and Kimball-style star-schema data models.
 Build and support Power BI semantic models and the datasets behind dashboards used by teams across the business.
 Implement data quality, validation and reconciliation checks so numbers match across systems.
 Monitor production pipelines and troubleshoot data, performance and refresh issues.
 Use Git, automated testing and CI/CD to support reliable, repeatable deployments.
 Maintain clear documentation, data lineage and engineering standards.
 Work with analysts and business stakeholders to turn requirements into practical data solutions.
 Be committed to maintaining our ISO27001 certification and set high standards for Information Security compliance.
